# High-level requirements

## Mandated

- Z-01 (from charter) - Consequential decisions name an accountable human.
- Z-02 (from charter) - Every model states boundary and assumptions.

## Constraints

- CON-01 - The methodology must remain independent of any software, storage,
  task tool or specific notation. Applying it on paper must be possible.

## Proposed needs (N)

- N-FR-01 - A team can compare two conceptual models for definition conflicts.
- N-FR-02 - A team can trace a decision to the model element it changes.
- N-QR-01 - A review should be repeatable by another competent reviewer.

## Design decisions (D)

- D-01 - Use scenario walkthroughs as one consistency technique. This is a
  design decision, not approval of every proposed need.

## Hypotheses (H)

- H-01 - Teams that separate process from physical assumptions produce fewer
  contradictions. Unvalidated.
